description: He wears a light cream linen ankle-length undertunic beneath a loose open brown robe with wide sleeves. Tan-and-dark-brown geometric embroidery runs down the front borders and around the cuffs. A matching woven sash wraps the waist with a fringed patterned end hanging down one side. Brown low leather slip-on shoes are fully visible. The clothing is opaque, breathable and practical; no headgear, armor or weapons appear.
